_source: Lifted verbatim from the canonical I-90 kit (bucket kit id 'i-90_v2') on 2026-09-03. Kits are bucket-canonical and NOT in git (CLAUDE.md scar #10), so re-lift from the bucket via scripts/pull-form-kits.sh, not from a path in this repo.

help.instructions: Part 1. Information About You. Mailing Address. 6. E. Select State from List of States.

label_translations.spanish: Islas Vírgenes de los EE. UU. (VI)

help.instructions: Give the feet part of your height. For example, if you are five feet nine inches tall, this is five. Do not give your height in meters or centimeters.
help.details:
## Height

Item Number 8.  Height.  Select the values that best match your height in feet and inches.  For example, if you are five 
feet and nine inches, select “5” for feet and “09” for inches.  Do not enter your height in meters or centimeters.

help.instructions: Give the inches part of your height, from zero to eleven. For example, if you are five feet nine inches tall, this is nine. Do not give your height in meters or centimeters.

_why_frozen: No git-tracked kit contains a single 'select' field, so a working-tree read of this rule skips in CI. These three are every long select the I-90 had; phys_state is omitted only because it is byte-identical to mail_state and would add 25KB for no extra coverage.
_coupling: Assumes ai_context.ASK_DIRECTLY_OPTION_TYPES exempts 'select' BEFORE the n > LONG_OPTION_LIST_THRESHOLD branch. The test asserts that precedence explicitly, so a threshold change cannot silently void it.
